answer: Sybil resistance is enforced by a non-collusive voting tree that weights each identity by a bonded stake deposited at a distinct jetty, so duplicate registrations collapse into one leaf. A dynamic penalty curve then slashes any cluster whose attestation graph shows a dune-like drift toward correlated voting, propagating a ripple of forfeiture across its sponsors. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
